_comment: Nightly gates, calibrated to DATASET v5 dev split. Measured band across repeat runs (generation + judge variance, +-0.03): faithfulness 0.86-0.90, relevancy 0.79-0.84, recall 0.87-0.92, precision 0.80-0.84, source_recall 1.0, source_precision 0.87-0.90. Floors sit below the band's low end so only real regressions trip. Recalibrate whenever the dataset version changes - thresholds are meaningless across dataset versions.
